summary.zh: 一座悬浮于星海的微小庇护所。绕树而行，看光芒与萤火一起呼吸。
summary.en: A tiny sanctuary adrift among the stars. Orbit a luminous tree and watch its light breathe with the fireflies.

coverAlt.zh: 深蓝星空中的悬浮岩岛，岛上生长着一棵紫色发光树，萤火围绕树冠。
coverAlt.en: A floating rock island in a dark blue starfield, with a luminous violet tree and drifting fireflies.

text.zh: 拖动就能绕着小岛转，滚轮或双指拉近，方向键也可以。
text.en: Drag to circle the island, scroll or pinch to move closer. The arrow keys work too.

tech.zh: 轨道相机 · 阻尼缓动 · 键盘操作

text.zh: 树冠的光和萤火，跟着同一个节奏一明一暗。
text.en: The glow of the tree and the fireflies brighten and dim to the same rhythm.

tech.zh: 13,500 片实例化树叶 · 实时辉光

text.zh: 拖动光芒滑块，从安静的夜色，一直调到满树发光。
text.en: Slide the glow from a quiet night all the way to a tree in full light.

tech.zh: 实时参数 · 无障碍滑块

text.zh: 打开声音，是浏览器实时合成的环境音；小岛下面，云在慢慢流动。
text.en: Turn on the sound for an ambience synthesized live in your browser, while clouds drift slowly beneath the island.

tech.zh: Web Audio 合成 · 程序化云层
